local_checks.result: A directory or file at profiles/thak/node_modules/dsh-omp-gateway is refused before anything is written (update-agent-assets.sh:2103-2106). A symlink there, whatever its target, is replaced: the new link is written as ${link}.tmp.$$ after a rm -f of that name (:2000-2004), then renamed over the name with python3's os.replace (:2005-2009). rename(2) replaces the link itself and never follows it, so a link pointing into a directory is not entered, and a failure at either step leaves the previous link standing and removes the temporary. The same function runs on the already-installed exit before the receipt is read (:2188), after the profile install on a fresh install (:2274) and in repair mode (:2277), so a host installed before the row existed, or one whose link was pointed elsewhere, converges. The receipt records the target and the physical link path (:1971).

hardening_notes: The temporary link name ${link}.tmp.$$ is predictable (update-agent-assets.sh:2000). It sits in the operator's own node_modules under DSH_HOME, so no other principal can pre-place it; rm -f clears a stale one first.
